name: @edgegamers/s2s-pug
description: Plays a PUG match: rostered teams, !ready, a knife round for sides, then the standard competitive config, with the score reported per team. The portal bridge feeds it matches from the EdgeGamers CS portal.

keep_awake.description: Turn off sv_hibernate_when_empty while a match is loaded. An empty server otherwise sleeps and never changes to the match map or starts warmup until someone joins. Set back when the match is cleared.

set_password.description: Give each match its own server password (sv_password) and report it to the portal, which shows it to the match's players in the join command. The previous password comes back when the match is cleared.

use_portal_names.description: Show rostered players under the name the match lists for them (their MAUL name from the portal), and give their own name back when the match is cleared.

kick_unrostered.description: During a match, kick players who are not in it (admins may stay and spectate). Off = they are kept on spectator.

side_choice_seconds.description: Seconds the knife round's winners have to type !stay or !switch before they stay.

map_change_delay_ms.description: Wait this long after a match arrives before changing map, so players read the message.

warmup_cfg.description: A cfg to exec when warmup starts (after the plugin's own warmup settings). Empty = none.

knife_cfg.description: A cfg to exec for the knife round (after the plugin's knife-only settings). Empty = none.

live_cfg.description: A cfg to exec after gamemode_competitive when the match goes live, for this server's overrides (e.g. overtime). Empty = none.
